content: samply 0.13.1 (2025-02-01), MSRV 1.77. macOS: mach task ports + DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES injection into launched processes, NO sudo, NO dtrace; Firefox Profiler UI; 1000 Hz default with on- and off-CPU samples per thread. Cannot profile Apple-signed system binaries (irrelevant for cargo-built rustkmer). samply setup self-signs the binary to enable attach-to-running-PID, still no sudo. Install: cargo install samply. Local zero-install alternatives verified present: /usr/bin/sample and /usr/bin/xctrace. cargo-flamegraph needs dtrace + sudo on macOS - avoid.
